narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.content: During the pipeline review, {data_dave} noted that the move from ingestion to validation still depends on a manual request. He described how the nightly point of sale scans and stock updates land in the staging area, after which a team member has to explicitly trigger the validation job. There is no automated signal or scheduled task that kicks this off. The system simply waits for that command before it starts checking data quality and completeness. The validation process only begins once someone sends the request, which is how the current nightly batch operates.
output.reclassify_reason: The artifact describes the current operational state of the pipeline without expressing any wishes, refusals, trade-offs, or explicit needs for change.
